    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`This configuration adds a custom query to the work list of Service Request app. Service request app has distinct way to load queries in the main page, this is useful when you want to filter the service requests based on a specific criteria.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use Cases:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Add a new saved-query to Service Request work list. In this case, we are going to use an existing saved-query “SERVICEREQUESTHISTORY”.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Display historical service requests separately from active requests for better organization`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Create custom filtered views for specific service request categories (e.g., by department, priority, or status)`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Prerequisites:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Basic understanding of datasources and saved queries`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Access to MAF Configuration application`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Familiarity with Service Request app structure`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Knowledge of AppCustomizations.js file structure`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Existing saved query configured in Maximo (e.g., SERVICEREQUESTHISTORY)`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>{`Implementation`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Step 1: Add a new override datasource as child of srDS datasource to set saved query.`}</h3>
    <p>{`srDS is the main datasource used to provide that from the main list, we use an override to take advantage of the existing parameters, including schema and attributes.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Location in app.xml:`}</strong>{`
Search for id=‘srDS’ and add the maximo-datasource-override as its child`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Add descriptive comments explaining key attributes -->
<maximo-datasource id="srDS" [...]>
    <!-- [...] -->
  </schema>
  <maximo-datasource-override id="historySrDS" selection-mode="none" saved-query="SERVICEREQUESTHISTORY" offline-immediate-download="false" lookup-data="false" page-size="5"/>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 2: Include the item in the work list dropdown`}</h3>
    <p>{`This is the dropdown that appears in the work list. We are going to add a new item to the dropdown that will be used to filter the work list.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Location in app.xml:`}</strong>{`
Search for id=‘rzvz4’ and add the following as its child`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<dropdown id="rzvz4" [...]>
  <!-- [...] -->
  <dropdown-item value="history" text="History SR" id="maqby"/>
</dropdown>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 3: Intercept the dropdown change event with your custom method`}</h3>
    <p>{`We modify the on-change event to call our custom method. This method will be responsible for handling the dropdown change event for configured new options.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Location in app.xml:`}</strong>{`
Search for id=‘rzvz4’ and update on-change value to call your custom method`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<dropdown slot="dropdown" on-change="customLoadSrListData" id="rzvz4" […]>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 4: Create the method to handle dropdown item change event`}</h3>
    <p>{`The method must load data from the new datasource if the selected dropdown item corresponds to that datasource. It should also invoke the original method to it resume its flow.
Here’s the complete implementation for replacing an existing method in AppCustomizations.js:`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Location in AppCustomizations.js:`}</strong>{`
Inside AppCustomizations class, add the following method`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`  async customLoadSrListData(evt) {
    try {
      const page = this.app.activePage || this.page || this.app.currentPage;
      this.app.state.pageLoading = true;
      page.state.selectedSwitch = 0;
      // Enable the line below to customize the empty message for saved query 
      // page.state.emptystring = this.app.getLocalizedMessage(this.app.name, 'noUnsyncedRequests', 'No unsynced requests');
      if (evt === 'history') {
        const srDs = this.app.findDatasource("historySrDS");
        if (srDs) {
          if (!srDs.initialized){
            await srDs.initializeQbe();
          }
          await srDs.load();
        }
      } else {
        let controller = page.findController((c) => c.constructor.name === 'SRPageController');
        if (controller) {
          await controller.loadSRListData(evt);
        } else {
          this.app.log.w(TAG, "customLoadSrListData: SRPageController not found");
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      this.app.log.e(TAG, "customLoadSrListData failed", err);
    } finally {
      this.app.state.pageLoading = false;
    }
  }
`}</code></pre>

      <li parentName="ul">

    <h2>{`Best Practices`}</h2>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`✅ Do:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Use descriptive IDs for datasource overrides that clearly indicate their purpose (e.g., “historySrDS” instead of “ds1”)`}</li>
